name: Zoox
sub: Robotaxi & passenger L4; Purpose-built robotaxi/pod makers; Robotaxi consumer services
leadership: Aicha Evans, CEO; Amazon has held Zoox as a standalone business since 2020
about: Amazon-owned robotaxi developer with a bidirectional purpose-built vehicle built without traditional driver controls. They are moving from free / waitlist operations toward broader commercialization.
model: Robotaxi service revenue over time; Amazon-backed capital and fleet ownership.
deployment: Las Vegas free public service and San Francisco waitlist/selected-user service; Hayward manufacturing facility.
metrics: Nearly 2M autonomous miles and 350,000+ riders by late March 2026 at a 4.72-star average; roughly 500,000 on the waitlist. Charges no fares anywhere pending an NHTSA Part 555 exemption (public comment opened 11 March 2026, up to 2,500 vehicles). Redesigned production robotaxi unveiled 24-25 June 2026.
signal: Unveiled their redesigned production robotaxi 24-25 June 2026 ahead of series production at Hayward; bookable through the Uber app in Las Vegas from summer 2026.

sources.title: CNBC: Amazon's Zoox unveils redesigned robotaxi ahead of upcoming expansion
Federal Register: Zoox receipt of application for temporary exemption from various FMVSS requirements; request for comment
